I've been a casual member of many web communities over the years, watched small sites grow into behemoths, watched some behemoths fade into obscurity (mySpace anyone?)

One thing remains the same on the web, the periodic need for reinvention, as old ideas and platforms are co-opted by the hungry world, or otherwise displaced by the collective efforts of millions of connected minds. Many of the old-guard clearinghouses of ideas and information have become suspect. Commercialized and censored, doctored and manipulated into a product to be sold and consumed.

It is important that we take our business elsewhere when this is apparent, to defend a FREE internet. This may prove to be the most important battle of our time.
